# ssp_security_content_config (Resource)

Manages the global Security Content service configuration (connectivity mode for cloud services such as signature/feature downloads).

This is a singleton resource — only one configuration can exist per SSP instance, with a fixed API-assigned ID of `scs-config`.
Use `terraform import ssp_security_content_config.this scs-config` to adopt an existing configuration.

Corresponds to `GET/PUT /ssp/security-content/config`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connectivity_mode` (String) Connectivity mode controlling connectivity to cloud services (e.g. `CONNECTED`, `DISCONNECTED`). If `connectivity_mode_changeable` is `false` server-side, an attempted change is rejected with an error.

### Read-Only

- `connectivity_mode_changeable` (Boolean) Whether `connectivity_mode` can currently be changed. Read-only.
- `id` (String) Always `scs-config` for this resource.
